summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native app 'Mqulima' tested end-to-end at mobile viewport 390x844. 46/46 critical flows passed after corrected sign-up filler (initial 2 'failures' were test-side mapping errors, re-run confirms both pass). Verified: bottom tabs, top bar, FABs, home ecosystem/featured/hero CTAs, AgroShop list + search + filters, cart badge increments, product detail with variant price switching (KSh 4,200 50KG -> KSh 2,200 25KG), qty controls, add-to-cart & buy-now, cart +/-/remove/total/checkout, checkout form (name, phone, county bottom-sheet with checkout-county-select-option-nairobi, subcounty, location), checkout-success, order visible in /account/orders, forum thread list, thread-like toggles count (10 -> 11), thread-comment while signed-out redirects to /auth/sign-in, create-post publishes with create-post-success, AI chat suggestion yields mocked reply, crop-doctor diagnose -> crop-doctor-result, services soil sub-service-request navigates to /service-request prefilled, sign-up submits -> /account and persists across reloads. No deprecated expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). No React Native red screen; only non-blocking web-only style deprecation warnings (textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents) from react-native-web.

issues: Non-blocking RN-Web console warnings: 'textShadow*' style props deprecated, 'shadow*' style props deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated. These are warnings from react-native-web for RN style props; native builds are unaffected. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: migrate textShadow* -> textShadow, shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence web warnings (cosmetic only).

Optional: on empty checkout submit, inline error messages did not render visible aria-labelled text (validation blocked submit correctly, but no verifiable error element string was returned). Consider adding testIDs for error messages (e.g., checkout-name-error) to aid future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean architecture: mock api under src/services/api.ts with simulated delays, AsyncStorage persistence via src/utils/storage, AppStore context. No backend coupling.
All interactive elements include testID props matching the review spec; naming conventions are consistent.
Sign-up form validates name/email/phone/county/password/confirm-password properly; redirects to /account on success and state persists across reloads via AsyncStorage.
Order creation works without login (guest checkout) and stored order appears in /account/orders - good UX.
No HTML elements leaking into RN tree; all text wrapped in <Text>. No red screen errors observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (46/46 critical flows after corrected sign-up fill)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created; app uses local mock data in /app/frontend/src/data/*.ts and AsyncStorage. Test registered a user jane2@example.com in AsyncStorage during E2E run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only Expo/web preview with mocked api. Use mobile viewport 390x844. Sign-up requires: name, email, phone, county (bottom-sheet select; option testIDs look like sign-up-county-select-option-<slug>), password AND confirm-password matching. Checkout county select option testID is checkout-county-select-option-nairobi. Thread comment requires sign-in - unauthenticated users are redirected to /auth/sign-in. All critical flows verified: home, shop, product/variants, cart, checkout, orders, forum (like, comment auth gate, create-post), AI chat, crop-doctor, services, sign-up persistence. Only cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings remain.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no real bugs identified. Initial 2 test failures were test-script issues: (1) sign-up has both password and confirm-password fields - a naive 'if password in testid' filler also matched confirm-password field incorrectly; (2) login persistence failure was downstream of the failed sign-up. Re-running with password + confirm-password set to the same value sign-up succeeds and /account is reachable after reload.
